param_input_item.param_description: Only the breakpoints of this file are listed; the error breakpoints are not included.
Shows the full path of the file followed by the function name instead of the function name alone.

param_output_item.param_description: Structure array listing breakpoints currently in effect.

description.p: dbstatus lists all breakpoints currently set, one line per file: Breakpoint for buggy is on line 3. or Breakpoints for buggy are on lines 2, 3., followed by the condition of each conditional breakpoint, then by Stop if error. and Stop if caught error. when these error breakpoints are set.
Assigning the output to a variable b allows you to save and restore breakpoints later using dbstop(b).

The output structure array b contains one element per file with breakpoints and one element per error breakpoint. Each element contains:
name: function name (empty for an error breakpoint)
file: full path to the file containing the breakpoints
line: row vector of breakpoint line numbers
anonymous: row vector of zeros (anonymous function breakpoints are not supported)
expression: cell row of the conditions, one per line, empty when unconditional
cond: 'error' or 'caught error' for an error breakpoint, empty otherwise
identifier: {'all'} for an error breakpoint, empty otherwise

example_item.example_item_description: Save current breakpoints and restore them later.
example_item.example_item_data: b = dbstatus(); save saved_breakpoints b dbclear all load saved_breakpoints dbstop(b)
